cues.text: Good morning! University Language Centre. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I'm interested in doing a language course. I did Mandarin last year and now I'd like to do Japanese. Can you give me some information about what courses are available at your centre and when they start. That sort of thing?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes, certainly. Well, we actually offer a number of courses in Japanese at different levels. Are you looking for full time or part time?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh! I couldn't manage full time as I work every day but evenings would be fine and certainly preferable to weekends.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well, we don't offer courses at the weekend anyway, but let me run through your options. We have a 12-week intensive course three hours three nights a week - that's our crash course! Or an eight month course two nights a week
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I think the crash course would suit me best as I'll be leaving for Japan in six months time.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Are you a beginner?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Not a complete beginner, no!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well ... we offer the courses three levels, beginners, lower intermediate and upper intermediate, though we don't always run them all. It depends very much on demand.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I'd probably be at the lower intermediate level - as I did some Japanese at school but that was ages ago.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Right, well the next Level Two course begins on Monday 12th September - there are still some places on that one - otherwise you'd have to wait until January or March.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No - I'd prefer the next course.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Right! Can I get some details from you then so I can send you some information?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Sure!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: What's your name? Family name first.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Hagerty. Richard.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: H A G A R T Y?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No. H-A-G-E-R-T-Y
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh, OK! And your address, Richard?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Well perhaps you could email it to me.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Right. What's your email address?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: It's ricky45 - that's one word R I C K Y 4 5, at hotmail dot com.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: And I just need some other information for our statistics. This helps us offer the best possible courses and draw up a profile of our students.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Fine!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: What's your date of birth?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I was born on 29th February 1980.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: ... 1980! So you're a leap year baby! That's unusual.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes - it is!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: ... and just one or two other questions for our market research, if you don't mind.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No, that's fine.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: What are your main reasons for studying Japanese? Business, travel or general interest.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: My company's sending me to Japan for two years.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Alright - I'll put down ' Business'. And do you have any specific needs? Will there be an emphasis on written language? For instance, will you need to know how to write business letters, that sort of thing?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No. But I will need to be able to communicate with people on a day-to-day basis.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: OK so I'll put down 'conversation'.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, because I already know something about the writing system at an elementary level and I don't anticipate having to read too much.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: You said you'd studied some Japanese. Where did you study?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Three years at school. Then I gave it up so I've forgotten a fair bit. You know how it is with languages if you don't have the chance to use them.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes, but I'm sure it will all come back to you once you get going again. Now once we receive your enrolment form we'll …
cues.speaker: Woman
